story.missionBrief:
=== MISSION BRIEFING ===
Role: Neural Network Architect
Type: PUZZLE

Objective: Connect 6 thought nodes to create stable consciousness bridge
Location: Neural network layer, Dream Nexus Alpha
Threat: Thought patterns fragmenting, consciousness destabilizing
Method: Link compatible thoughts, avoid contradictions
Time Constraint: 80 seconds before thought patterns completely fragment

=== AVAILABLE ABILITIES ===
• Thought Link: Connect two compatible thought nodes (5 seconds cooldown)
• Pattern Sense: Reveal compatible thought connections (12 seconds cooldown)
• Consciousness Anchor: Stabilize one thought node permanently [3 charges]

=== STAKES ===
Success: Bridge complete, consciousness network stable
Failure: Thoughts fragment, neural network collapses
